metadata.description: Vendor-signed skill packs for IBM Bob. Install with `uvx bob-skills add <pack>`; other agents may read this manifest to discover packs.

plugins.name: bob-essentials
plugins.description: Skills of the marketplace itself: find-skills proposes a pack when Bob lacks a capability, skill-creator writes SKILL.md files that pass Bob and the policy linter, guard explains and resolves blocked skill activations. Ships the /skills-add command.

plugins.name: wxo
plugins.description: Official watsonx Orchestrate ADK skills for the whole agent lifecycle (requirements, SOP, build, audit, telemetry, instruction quality), the ADK and documentation MCP servers, an ADK rule, a /wxo-deploy command and a wxo-builder mode.
